requestContext.decisions:
architect: Build a Web App named Peer Gate Notes for a learner collecting plain text notes. The accepted scope is the following complete list:
1. A Home page headed Peer Gate Notes.
2. A note form with a required Title field; trim input and reject blank titles.
3. List the saved title and its slug in insertion order, in memory only; reload clears entered notes.
4. Use the real npm package slugify@1.6.6, dynamically imported when saving, to generate a lowercase URL-safe slug from each Title while preserving the original Title.
5. An About page explaining the in-memory data behavior.
6. Home/About navigation.
7. Ten separate onboarding text components, all visible on Home, with these exact labels and useful instructions: Purpose; Add a title; Save a note; Read your list; Understand the slug; Visit About; Return Home; Reload behavior; Plain text safety; Keep learning.
8. Generate a complete working app with its dependency manifest, lockfile and executable tests. No authentication, backend, persistent note storage, editing or deletion is requested. Use the current supported deterministic Web App profile and the smallest compatible catalog architecture. These choices are settled; provide the starting architecture when ready, without optional feature questions.
